name: dev-skills
description: Claude Code plugins for code quality: dev-core (stack-agnostic practices, role agents, safety hooks) and dev-patterns (TypeScript full-stack patterns).

plugins.name: dev-core
plugins.description: Stack-agnostic engineering practices for any project: Clean Architecture and tactical DDD, test patterns (fakes, contract and repository integration tests, mutation testing), error handling, database migrations, domain events (outbox, saga), logging/observability, API contracts, auth/security, git conventions, a pre-merge review gate, resilience patterns, secrets rotation, time zones (date-time), privacy compliance (GDPR/LGPD, versioned consent), a full-repository audit protocol, a stack-agnostic project bootstrap with context-file templates, 8 role agents (architect, tech-lead, backend/frontend developer, dba, devops, qa, appsec) that read the project's own stack and rules, and safety hooks that ask before destructive commands and before writing likely secrets.

plugins.name: dev-patterns
plugins.description: Patterns for TypeScript full-stack projects (NestJS/Fastify, Supabase/Postgres, Expo/React Native, pnpm monorepo; deploy on Railway/Cloudflare/EAS/GitHub Actions): Clean Architecture, API contracts, auth, migrations, testing, caching, queues, observability, mobile UX, email, a project bootstrap guide, and a post-write TypeScript lint hook. Use together with dev-core.
